errors.text_span: с етикети, разположени с интервал от един квартал
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not for every quarter. The interval between displayed labels is 5 quarters (e.g., from 2003Q1 to 2004Q2).
The y-axis label is not present, and the scale (0-600) makes it extremely unlikely that the values represent percentages. This is an unsupported interpretation.

errors.text_span: Осите са означени съответно като „Общо Безработица“
errors.evidence: „Общо Безработица“ is the title of the chart, not a label for either of the axes. The axes themselves are not labeled.
The phrase "със спрян маркер" (with a stopped marker) is nonsensical and does not clearly describe the solid blue line.
The minimum value around 2009 is approximately 180, not 150.
The local minimum in 2019 occurs in Q2, not Q1, and the value is closer to 125, not 150.
The final value in 2021Q4 is approximately 150, not 180.
